design_intent: Replicate the attached dark-mode Focus Sprint ritual selection screen with a deeper, more premium navy-black background, glowing violet accents, frosted dark cards, and clean student-friendly Bodhi visual language. The screen should feel calm, focused, immersive, and premium — not like a generic Pomodoro app.

background.description: Make the background slightly darker than the reference, almost midnight navy/black, but keep subtle blue-violet glow near the center so white text remains readable and premium. Avoid flat black. Add very subtle grain/noise if supported.

visual_style.overall_mood: premium, calm, focused, ritualistic, subtle sci-fi, Bodhi wellness app

layout.vertical_spacing: generous but compact enough to fit all elements without scroll
screen_sections: top back button and centered screen label

headline.text: How do you want to start?

subtitle.text: Set your intention. We'll help you stay in the flow.

option_cards.title: 2 min Breathwork
option_cards.description:

icon_containers.placement: left side of each card, vertically centered

recommended_badge.placement: to the right of the option title, aligned baseline/top

info_card.text:
Starting with breathwork or meditation
can improve your focus and retention.
info_card.description: Keep this card visually lighter than option cards. It is an insight, not a CTA.

bottom_navigation.position: fixed bottom, y around 780 to bottom safe area depending on canvas height

interaction_requirements.option_selection: Tapping any option should select it, show violet border and circular checkmark, and unselect the others.
interaction_requirements.breathwork: When selected, this should route to a 2-minute breathwork screen before focus timer.
interaction_requirements.meditation: When selected, this should route to a 5-minute meditation preparation screen before focus timer.
interaction_requirements.bottom_nav: Keep bottom nav visible and consistent with app language. Center sparkle button should feel active but not overpowering.
interaction_requirements.back_button: Back button returns to previous Focus Sprint setup screen.

animation_guidance.screen_entry: Fade in headline and subtitle, then stagger option cards upward by 8px with 180ms delay each.
animation_guidance.selection_change: Selected card border and checkmark animate with 180ms ease-out. Add subtle violet glow on selected card only.
animation_guidance.background: Very slow subtle ambient blue-violet gradient movement if supported. No distracting animation.

accuracy_notes: Do not use the existing light-mode screen styling for this screen. Replace it with the dark-mode reference style.
Make the background darker than the reference image, but preserve contrast and premium readability.
Keep card spacing, icon scale, type hierarchy, rounded corners, and purple glow very close to the reference.
Avoid childish gradients, overly bright neon, heavy glass blur, or generic Material UI cards.
The screen should look like a polished production mobile app screen, not an AI-generated mockup.

negative_prompt: Do not create a white or light background.
Do not make the screen look like a generic productivity timer.
Do not overuse blur or glow.
Do not make the cards too tall or text too small.
Do not remove the bottom nav.
Do not use random icons different from lightning, breath lines, lotus, brain, sun, clock, sparkle, compass, and journey trend.
Do not crop important elements near the bottom safe area.
